steps.text: The last tab of your profile controls how OptimCE tells you about things.
steps.title: Notifications tab

steps.text: Each row is a kind of activity — news, invoices, deadlines… — and each column a channel. "Everything else" covers the categories without a row of their own. Essential messages (invoices, invitations, missed deadlines) are always delivered.
steps.title: Categories and channels

steps.text: Switch "Email" off on the "News posts" row: you will still see the posts inside the application, but no email will be sent.
steps.title: Turn a channel off

steps.text: Nothing is applied until you save. Click "Save preferences".
steps.title: Save

steps.text: A confirmation appears next to the button. It clears as soon as you change a setting again.
steps.title: Preferences saved
